dedupe_keys.name: pommes german wholesale power dispatch model

description: pommesdispatch is the dispatch component of the POMMES German wholesale power-market model. Its developer group publishes Python source, installation steps and documentation; separate repositories cover data preparation and planned investment modelling. A user supplies German generation, storage, demand-response and renewable-infeed inputs for a chosen year or period between 2017 and 2030. The model minimises power-system costs and returns dispatch of backup plants, storage and flexible demand. Its geographic scope is Germany, with bidding zones, not full internal network constraints. The README states MIT terms for the software. A limitation is that renewable output is exogenous and the model omits most network constraints; it cannot by itself resolve local congestion. The tool supports wholesale-market flexibility and adequacy scenarios. The catalogue's model-pypsa-eur is a different European optimisation model, not a POMMES dependency. No POMMES dataset or solver was run.
inputs: German generation, demand-response and storage data
